title: The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis (alternate 11/12 proof)

abstractEnglish: We establish the quasi-Riemann hypothesis by proving that every Dirichlet L-function, including Riemann's zeta function, has no zeros in the half-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{Re}}\nolimits s\gt 11/12`$. More generally, we prove the same zero-free half-plane for every finite-order Hecke L-function over $`K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$. In particular, this rules out the existence of Landau–Siegel zeros.
